The trend of building a remote team for custom software solutions is continuously increasing all around the world due to many good reasons. Thus, numerous SaaS experts and business people team up to start a SaaS application development company for achieving the better business prospects in the industry. Let’s have a deeper perspective of the SaaS development and its business landscape in this article.

Software as a Service (SaaS) Solutions

The software as a service (SaaS) is a category of the business model in the cloud computing field, which offers the multi-talent software resources to different companies accessible through browser and internet connectivity. In other words, the third party SaaS service providers host the SaaS service and allow access to their customers through subscription. If you’re exploring custom SaaS development, it can help you build tailored solutions for your unique business needs, offering flexibility and scalability as your operations grow.

SaaS Brief History

The history of SaaS solutions dates back about 50 years when the time sharing of computing resources were introduced through dumb terminals in the 1960s. The pioneer of the precursor of SaaS service was IBM who started offering the computing resources through its framework computers. In the 1980s and 1990s, the application service providers (ASP) model of business emerged. The main provider of ASP service included FutureLink Corporation and USI Inc. The term ‘SaaS’ was coined in a technical article internally published in Software Information Industry Association (SIIA) publishing in 2000. The present form of SaaS solutions fully managed, multitenant, and centrally hosted came into existence by 2012.

Top 20 SaaS Solutions Worldwide

There are thousands of SaaS companies operating different types of software services based on the B2B and B2C models of services. Let’s have a look at the top 20 popular SaaS solutions worldwide.

#1 Google Suite

A cloud-based individual SaaS service that includes Gmail, Calendar, Photos, Google Drive and much more is a very popular service all over the world. New features are consistently being added in this suite of services.

#2 Microsoft

Microsoft offers a wide range of SaaS services for individuals as well as for the businesses. These SaaS services include Dynamic CRM, SQL Server, Office 365, SharePoint and many others. Other than these services, Microsoft is also offering other cloud-based services like Azure.

#3 Slack

Slack is a SaaS-based collaboration solution commonly used in managing remote teams. This suite consists of multiple tools used for establishing communication, tracking work hours and much more. It has a huge user-base of over 6 million users.

#4 GitHub

GitHub is one of the leading software development platforms where the software developers can develop many projects in a collaborative environment. More than 85 software repositories are posted on the GitHub. There are millions of software developers that create one of the large communities in the domain of technology.

#5 ZenDesk

This is one of the biggest online customer service solution based on the SaaS cloud model. The Zendesk platform has revolutionized the customer service by offering a multi-channel customer support service like live chat, ticket management, email support, and call center.

#6 Box

The box is a data storage, secure file-sharing, and collaborative platform. It is a SaaS cloud service offered to both the individuals and the businesses. It is a highly secure way of electronic file sharing and storage platform. It also offers collaborative document editing as well as an electronic signature service.

#7 New Relic

New Relic is an online web performance and software testing solution. It offers numerous additional solutions like analytics of software performance, professional reporting, SLA agreements and much more. The software development company offers services to over 15 thousand business customers globally.

#8 Oracle SaaS Solutions

All major services offered by Oracle like ERP, SCM, HR, and payroll have been shifted to SaaS platforms. Oracle is one of the leading providers of the SaaS services to the customers.

#9 GoToMeeting Service

This is a highly popular online meeting service with numerous meeting management features. It is growing very rapidly in the marketplace.

#10 HubSpot Marketing

It is a powerful marketing service for all kinds of businesses. It offers numerous features like social marketing, analytics, SEO, and others.

#11 Atlassian

Atlassian is a powerful provider of online software solutions. The most popular solution of this SaaS software development company is JIRA used by the software development community.

#12 Shopify

Shopify is a comprehensive retail and eCommerce solution for SMEs. It offers numerous features like inventory management and online store and website management. If you need help with customizations or building your store, consider hiring experienced Shopify programmers.

#13 Splunk

Splunk offers a SaaS platform for data analysis and business intelligence solutions. It monitors real data and provides desired information to the users.

#14 Druva Backup Storage

It offers SaaS-based data storage and regular data backups. The storage services of Druva can easily be integrated with major online services like office 365, Box, and others.

#15 Survey Monkey

The leading online survey conducting service runs as a cloud-based SaaS service. It is very popular in many types of businesses to collect the desired information suitable for the businesses respectively.

#16 Anaplan

It is one of the best business planning software extensively adopted by the CEOs and enterprise all over the world. It is considered as a powerful data analysis and business model generator platform.

#17 Domo

It is a business intelligence and data analysis SaaS platform extensively used by the business people and marketers. This is a very popular platform in all kinds of businesses and industries all over the world.

#18 Xero

It is an online SaaS-based accounting software. It is very popular in the finance and human resource management teams of all kinds and sizes of businesses globally.

#19 DocuSign

DocuSign is a business document management platform, which helps reduce the paperwork and increase the speed of secure document dispatching and handling.

#20 Cisco WebEx

Cisco offers WebEx communication service as a SaaS platform. It is gaining popularity in the domain of business communication globally.

Why to Hire SaaS Developer – Need, Role & Responsibilities

The demand for SaaS programmers is very high in the marketplace due to the fast growth of SaaS development services across the world. The total size of the public cloud SaaS market is about $105 billion, and it is expected to reach the $132.57 billion mark by 2020.

Why Hire SaaS Software Developer?

The main reasons to hire a SaaS engineer include the following:

  • A huge growth of SaaS services in the marketplace
  • Helps in developing professional grade SaaS platform
  • Helps develop custom solutions 100% fit for the unique business needs
  • Maintains the industry standards for SaaS service
  • Helps in improving the security, reliability, and efficiency of the service
  • Helps in achieving the competitive edge over the competitors
  • Reducing the effective cost of the software development
  • Helps in improving the service ranking and user experience
  • Helps to improve the project delivery time

SaaS Developer Responsibilities

SaaS developer should be a full-stack developer that can meet the requirements to work on the modern SaaS application development platforms. The main responsibilities of SaaS programmer include the following:

  • Assessing the customer requirements and translating into the design components
  • Implementing the application design into the software code
  • Developing online tools that support SaaS development
  • Developing test cases to check the quality of the code
  • Developing and implementing debugging process
  • Programming in the cloud environment
  • Developing application programming interface APIs
  • Developing data pipelines
  • Developing software prototype
  • Improvement in the application design
  • Making desired changes in the code
  • Carrying out SaaS management of cloud resources
